title: Concept: Possible password value in an unquoted assignment in source
description: password value in an unquoted assignment in source grants the access it names to every reader of the repository until it is rotated.
applicability: Environment files, YAML/INI/TOML configuration, connection strings, and source code that may embed password value in an unquoted assignment.
risk: Service access with the credential's scopes; HIGH severity.
